key_findings: Mrgprd expression is increased in NP2 DRG neurons of HFD mice and Mrgprd deletion prevents static mechanical allodynia in painful diabetic neuropathy.
Mrgprd-positive cutaneous afferents persist in diabetic skin and beta-alanine activation produces DRG nociceptor hyperexcitability, unlike Nav1.8 fibers which are lost.
